items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: No, he came with Erskine Hawkins.

ctx.x: Do you know what band he was with when he came out? He didn't have his own band at that time, did he, Erskine?
No, he came with Erskine Hawkins.
No, I said did Erskine come with another band? Erskine Hawkins.
